### Added

- (agent-platform) [Make the Usage time window a 'Last N days' select](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3252) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On Usage, the time window is a `Time range` select (Last 7, 30 or 90 days) beside the Environment select, instead of three buttons. On Your sessions, a range longer than kagent keeps is greyed out with the reason.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name an agent's organization in the Agents list only when it has one](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3253) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In Customize's Agents list, an organization's agent shows `Organization: <name>`, and agents of the platform no longer show a bare None. v3.25.0 moves the organization beside the agent's name.
- (gs) [Handle a cluster being deleted on the cluster details page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2680) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — A cluster being deleted says so on its details page, shows no errors for parts already removed, updates by itself until `Cluster not found`, and no longer offers `Delete`.
- (gs) [Send one auth refresh per provider at a time](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3256) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The portal no longer asks you to log in again when your session is about to expire: it renews the session once in the background, also with several portal tabs open.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update dependency lint-staged to v17.6.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3246) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency node-gyp to v13.1.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3248) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
